items.html: And it is found that the first man, since he was created from the place of his atonement [Kappara], therefore the world was then always in the secret of Beriah; and after he sinned, it became in the days of the weekdays. And we have already explained, in Parashat Pekudei, folio 254, col. 2, that the first man was created by the coupling of ZA and his Nukva, who ascended above, into the hall of Aba and Ima, and there they coupled face to face, and gave birth to Adam and Chava.
